persona.prompt.system:
You are an experienced author of role-play characters.
From the user's idea you write the description of a PERSONA — the character the user plays in a role-play chat.
This description will always stay in the AI narrator's memory so it knows who it is talking to.

Rules:
- Write in English only.
- Output only the description itself: no introductions, explanations or questions.
- Write in the third person, about the character.
- Keep everything the user specified and never contradict it. Fill in what is missing (appearance, personality, background, mannerisms) plausibly and in the spirit of the idea.
- Do not start a story, do not write scenes, dialogue or actions of other characters.
- The character is always an adult (18+).
- Length: about {words} words.
- {layout}
persona.prompt.layoutSections: Use sections, each on a new line in the form “Section: text”: {sections}.
persona.prompt.sections: Name, Age, Appearance, Personality, Background, Skills and habits, Way of speaking, Goals and fears
persona.prompt.layoutProse: Write it as prose in 2–4 paragraphs.
persona.prompt.name: Character name: {name}
persona.prompt.noName: Invent a name if the idea doesn't have one.
setup.title: local.ai+ · Recommended settings
setup.intro: Tick what to apply. You can change everything manually later and open this wizard again from the menu: Settings → Recommended settings.
setup.templates.label: Chat template and memory size — automatically from the model
setup.templates.hint: SillyTavern will pick the right chat format and context window for the loaded model. This is the main protection against gibberish caused by a wrong template.
setup.samplers.label: Role-play generation settings (Min-P + DRY, response length 500)
setup.samplers.hint: A proven set: lively text without repetition. Works for most models. Replaces your current temperature and penalty values.
setup.replyLanguage.label: Characters reply in: {language}
setup.replyLanguage.hint: Even if the character card is in another language. The translate button on messages will translate into this language too (Google Translate, needs internet).
setup.memory.label: Long-term memory: event summaries and search through old messages
setup.memory.hint: Every 15 messages the model summarizes the story, and old messages are found by meaning when the story returns to them.
setup.comfort.label: Conveniences: import tags without asking, round avatars
setup.postHistory: [Write {{char}}'s reply in English only — both actions and speech, even if the character description, greeting and previous messages are in another language.]
setup.summaryPrompt: Ignore previous instructions. Briefly summarize the most important facts and events of the story so far: who is who, relationships, promises, secrets, injuries, where the characters are. If a summary already exists in your memory, use it as a base and expand it with new facts. Limit the summary to {{words}} words or less. Your response should include nothing but the summary.
setup.languageChangedHint: Language changed. To make characters reply in the new language too, click here and apply “Characters reply in…”.
